title: Storyboard gate before a full render
summary: Compact board columns and the ten challenge questions a storyboard must survive before a substantial render: clear opening promise, because/therefore middle, fair plant, resolved question, no filler shots.
evidence_notes: Editorial guidance from the owner's guide, written after Taylor rejected BOXED IN's story quality. Its review methods (table read, silent animatic, owner storyboard choice) are proposed; nothing here is validated audience research.
